# Why the Sky Is Blue

The blue sky is caused by **Rayleigh scattering** — the scattering of sunlight off molecules in Earth's atmosphere (mainly nitrogen and oxygen).

## How It Works

**1. Sunlight contains all colors.**
Sunlight appears white but is actually made up of all the colors of the rainbow, each with a different wavelength. Violet and blue have short wavelengths; red and orange have long ones.
